title: Investigation of Cognitive Function Before and After Induced Ventricular Fibrillation in Electrophysiological (EP) Study
brief_summary: In this study, changes in electroencephalogram (EEG) and the hemodynamic state during ventricular fibrillation or induced ventricular tachycardia are investigated.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \> 18 years
* Positive agreement
* EPS for primary and secondary prophylaxis of a malignant ventricular tachyarrhythmia:

  * primary prophylaxis: Brugada syndrome, long QT syndrome, cardiomyopathy, short QT syndrome
  * secondary prophylaxis: Multicenter Automatic Defibrillator Implantation Trial (MADIT) criteria, syncope, documented ventricular tachycardia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe neurological deficit
* Cardiopulmonary resuscitation
